**Cause:** `OrdersPage.__init__` registered only the Refresh handler. Clicking Export looked up a handler that didn't exist and silently did nothing. The `export()` method itself was fine, so the existing test that called it directly passed and missed the problem.

- `src/orders-web/orders_page.py`: one line, `self._on("export", self.export)`, added next to the Refresh registration.
- `tests/test_orders_web.py`: new test `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which clicks `"export"` through `click()`.
